capabilities: Sync courses, assignments, announcements and grades from Canvas
Write one managed-block course note per course with task-format assignments
Generate a This week note of overdue and upcoming work across courses
Produce an .ics calendar feed of upcoming deadlines
Hide, rename and alias courses from the plugin settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works only at schools that allow personal access tokens; free and open source (MIT), no telemetry.
motivation: Part of the Companion suite of local-first plugins where the machine does the work, every change is a diff you approve, and numbers are published.
problem: Students using Canvas have no way to see their assignments, deadlines, grades and announcements inside their vault alongside their notes without checking the LMS.

relations.evidence: Canvas Companion and Lecture Companion use the same Courses/<Course>.md note names, so Lecture Companion's notes land next to the assignments

summary: Syncs Canvas LMS assignments, due dates, grades and announcements into per-course task notes, a weekly due-work note, and an .ics calendar feed.
